equivalent.de: gute Laune haben, gut drauf sein

usage.en: be in a good/great/bad/weird mood · put sb in a good mood (cause). Don't confuse with: be in the mood for sth / to do sth = to feel like something.
usage.tr: be in a good/great/bad/weird mood · put sb in a good mood (sebep). Karıştırma: be in the mood for sth / to do sth = canı bir şey istemek.

collocations.en: in a really good mood · in no mood for jokes
collocations.tr: in a really good mood · in no mood for jokes

sentences.en: You're [in a good mood] today — what's going on?
sentences.de: Du hast ja heute gute Laune – was ist los?

sentences.en: That call from my sister put me [in a great mood].
sentences.tr: Kız kardeşimin araması keyfimi yerine getirdi.
sentences.de: Der Anruf von meiner Schwester hat mir richtig gute Laune gemacht.

meaning.en: to be extremely pleased and excited
meaning.de: sich riesig freuen und aufgeregt sein

usage.en: thrilled with (result/thing) · about (news/event) · to + verb · (that) + clause. The ironic negative is very common: "not exactly thrilled".
usage.tr: thrilled with (sonuç/nesne) · about (haber/olay) · to + fiil · (that) + cümle. Olumsuz ironik kullanım çok yaygın: "not exactly thrilled".

sentences.en: I'm [thrilled] about the internship — I didn't think I'd get it.
sentences.tr: Staj için çok mutluyum, alacağımı düşünmüyordum.
sentences.de: Ich freue mich riesig über das Praktikum – ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass ich es bekomme.

sentences.en: She wasn't exactly [thrilled] when I told her I was moving out.
sentences.de: Sie war nicht gerade begeistert, als ich ihr sagte, dass ich ausziehe.

equivalent.de: überglücklich sein, im siebten Himmel sein

usage.en: be over the moon (about/with sth). Not gradable: ✗ very over the moon → absolutely over the moon.
usage.tr: be over the moon (about/with sth). Derecelendirilmez: ✗ very over the moon → absolutely over the moon.

sentences.en: She was [over the moon] when she found out she'd passed.
sentences.de: Sie war überglücklich, als sie erfuhr, dass sie bestanden hatte.

sentences.en: My parents are [over the moon] about the baby.
sentences.de: Meine Eltern sind überglücklich über das Baby.

meaning.en: to be very excited and eager about something coming up
meaning.tr: yaklaşan bir şey için çok heyecanlı ve hevesli olmak
meaning.de: sich sehr auf etwas Bevorstehendes freuen und voller Energie sein

equivalent.tr: gaza gelmiş olmak, heyecandan yerinde duramamak
equivalent.de: total gespannt sein, Bock haben, voll motiviert sein

usage.en: pumped/psyched/stoked for + event · about + situation · to + verb. Don't confuse with: psych sb out = to unsettle someone mentally.
usage.tr: pumped/psyched/stoked for + etkinlik · about + durum · to + fiil. Karıştırma: psych sb out = birini psikolojik olarak bozmak.

sentences.en: I'm so [pumped] for the concert on Friday!
sentences.tr: Cuma günkü konser için çok heyecanlıyım!
sentences.de: Ich freue mich so auf das Konzert am Freitag!

sentences.en: He's [stoked] about his new job.
sentences.de: Er ist total begeistert von seinem neuen Job.

meaning.en: chuffed: pleased and a little proud about a result · buzzing: "humming" with excitement and energy
meaning.tr: chuffed: bir sonuçtan memnun ve gururlu olmak · buzzing: heyecanla "vızıldamak", enerji dolu olmak
meaning.de: chuffed: zufrieden und ein bisschen stolz über ein Ergebnis · buzzing: vor Aufregung und Energie „summen“

equivalent.tr: pek memnun olmak; heyecandan içi içine sığmamak

usage.en: chuffed with/about sth · chuffed to bits · buzzing for/about sth
usage.tr: chuffed with/about sth · chuffed to bits · buzzing for/about sth

sentences.en: I'm really [chuffed] with how the presentation went.
sentences.de: Ich bin richtig zufrieden damit, wie die Präsentation gelaufen ist.

sentences.en: I'm absolutely [buzzing] for tonight.
sentences.tr: Bu gece için içim içime sığmıyor.
sentences.de: Ich bin total aufgekratzt wegen heute Abend.

meaning.en: to be impatient for something to happen

usage.en: can't wait to + verb · can't wait for + noun · can't wait for sb to + verb
usage.tr: can't wait to + fiil · can't wait for + isim · can't wait for sb to + fiil

sentences.en: I [can't wait] to see you guys next week.
sentences.de: Ich kann es kaum erwarten, euch nächste Woche zu sehen.

sentences.en: I [can't wait] for this semester to be over.
sentences.de: Ich kann es kaum erwarten, dass dieses Semester vorbei ist.

meaning.en: to await something in the future with pleasure

usage.en: look forward to + noun / V-ing. This "to" is a preposition, not the infinitive marker!
usage.tr: look forward to + isim / V-ing. Buradaki "to" edattır, mastar eki değil!

collocations.en: really looking forward to it · look forward to hearing from you (letter/email formula)
collocations.tr: really looking forward to it · look forward to hearing from you (yazışma kalıbı)

sentences.en: I'm really [looking forward to] the weekend.
sentences.de: Ich freue mich wirklich aufs Wochenende.

sentences.en: I'm [looking forward to] finally meeting her.
sentences.tr: Onunla nihayet tanışmayı dört gözle bekliyorum.
sentences.de: Ich freue mich darauf, sie endlich kennenzulernen.

meaning.en: to become happier / to make someone happier

literal.en: cheer = gladness; up = upward (the HAPPY IS UP metaphor)
literal.tr: cheer = neşe; up = yukarı (MUTLU = YUKARI metaforu)

usage.en: cheer up (intransitive: you become cheerful yourself) · cheer sb up (transitive, separable: you cheer someone else up) · Imperative: "Cheer up!"
usage.tr: cheer up (geçişsiz: kendisi neşelenir) · cheer sb up (geçişli, ayrılabilir: başkasını neşelendirir) · Emir: "Cheer up!"

sentences.en: [Cheer up] — it's not the end of the world.
sentences.de: Kopf hoch – davon geht die Welt nicht unter.

sentences.en: I brought you ice cream to [cheer you up].
sentences.tr: Moralin düzelsin diye sana dondurma getirdim.
sentences.de: Ich habe dir Eis mitgebracht, um dich aufzumuntern.

meaning.en: to make someone very happy with something small
meaning.tr: küçük bir şeyle birini çok mutlu etmek
meaning.de: jemanden mit einer Kleinigkeit sehr glücklich machen

equivalent.de: jemandem den Tag retten, jemandem den Tag versüßen

usage.en: sth/sb makes my day. Usually in the past: "That made my day."
usage.tr: sth/sb makes my day. Genellikle geçmiş zamanda: "That made my day."

sentences.en: Your message totally [made my day].
sentences.de: Deine Nachricht hat mir echt den Tag gerettet.

sentences.en: A stranger complimented my jacket and it [made my day].
sentences.tr: Tanımadığım biri ceketime iltifat etti, bütün gün mutlu oldum.
sentences.de: Ein Fremder hat meine Jacke gelobt, und das hat mir den Tag versüßt.

meaning.en: to get so excited that you go too far
meaning.de: sich vor Begeisterung hinreißen lassen und übertreiben

literal.en: to be swept off and carried away

usage.en: Always passive in form: get/be carried away (with sth). Active "carry sb away" is hardly used in this sense.
usage.tr: Hep edilgen görünümde: get/be carried away (with sth). Etken "carry sb away" bu anlamda pek kullanılmaz.

collocations.en: get a bit carried away · Don't get carried away.
collocations.tr: get a bit carried away · Don't get carried away.

sentences.en: I only meant to buy one shirt, but I [got a bit carried away].
sentences.tr: Tek bir gömlek alacaktım ama biraz kendimi kaptırdım.
sentences.de: Ich wollte nur ein Hemd kaufen, aber ich habe mich ein bisschen hinreißen lassen.

sentences.en: Let's not [get carried away] — it was just one good interview.
sentences.tr: Hemen havaya girmeyelim, alt tarafı iyi geçen tek bir mülakat.
sentences.de: Übertreiben wir es nicht – es war nur ein gutes Vorstellungsgespräch.

equivalent.tr: çok eğlenmek, bomba gibi vakit geçirmek

usage.en: have a blast (at/with) · "It was a blast."
usage.tr: have a blast (at/with) · "It was a blast."

sentences.en: We [had a blast] at the wedding.
sentences.de: Wir hatten einen Riesenspaß auf der Hochzeit.

sentences.en: Thanks for coming — I [had a blast].
sentences.tr: Geldiğin için sağ ol, çok eğlendim.
sentences.de: Danke, dass du gekommen bist – es war super.

meaning.en: to burst out laughing / to make someone laugh a lot
meaning.de: in Gelächter ausbrechen / jemanden sehr zum Lachen bringen

usage.en: crack up (intransitive: start laughing) · crack sb up (transitive: make laugh). Older/rare meaning: to have a nervous collapse.
usage.tr: crack up (geçişsiz: gülmeye başlamak) · crack sb up (geçişli: güldürmek). Eski/nadir anlam: sinir krizi geçirmek.

sentences.en: I [cracked up] when I saw his costume.
sentences.de: Ich habe mich kaputtgelacht, als ich sein Kostüm gesehen habe.

sentences.en: She [cracks me up] — she's the funniest person I know.
sentences.tr: Beni çok güldürüyor, tanıdığım en komik insan.
sentences.de: Bei ihr lache ich mich kaputt – sie ist der lustigste Mensch, den ich kenne.
